scope: Bounded handwritten Proxy/VSAI diagnostics and cross-package exact-instance evidence; pure Go, no persistence.

priority_selection.reason: Batch101 prioritized selected manual Proxy/VSAI diagnostics with exact-instance evidence and bounded replies.

assertions: Manual Proxy-Host invalid Identity maps5004; unknown Mandatory children in Proxy/VSAI map5001; repeated known singleton children map5009; VSAI u32 width failures map5014; missing VendorId uses a fixed four-byte5005 placeholder.

Generatorv18 carries versioned manual evidence through generated parents and across package boundaries without internal imports. Repeated ancestor offsets and exact leaf header/data/padding remain available; metadata retains no request bytes.

The bounded walker independently checks path/key/flags/offset/type width/repetition/depth/count/frame/reply constraints before allocating a quote. Bare sentinels, malformed framing, resource errors and conditional multi-leaf rules gain no guessed mapping.
All present-field quotes own bytes. Repeated CER VSAI acceptance is offline codec evidence, not a handshake-specific response implementation.

VSAI application requests receive ordinary/emergency TCP/TLS E responses only with a complete valid envelope; invalid requests are not delivered, held charges remain stable and subsequent valid work succeeds.
A damaged Proxy cannot be safely echoed. Exact decoder evidence exists, but automatic network response remains closed without dropping or inventing fields.
Empty binary Proxy-State and optional opaque extras retain prior behavior; profiles explicitly ignoring VSAI remain opaque.
Public signatures/layouts, ops9 and protocol/profile slice inputs unchanged. Generatorv18 changes eleven digests and Bundle fingerprints; original-build recovery restriction remains.
Eleven finite fuzz targets, full dual-module static/pure/race/cross checks, pressure and separately sampled benchmarks. No new release tag, persistence or real-target claim.
